patch_note: No patch: ISA admission is an explicit effective-CPU/feature contract (TC03), not a workaround.
defect: BPF v4 is a compiler preset, not a kernel promise, and its meaning expanded across LLVM releases: LLVM 18 v4 is the original bundle (signed loads/moves, byte swap, signed div/rem, long jumps, imm stores); acquire/release and indirect jumps joined later. Linux 6.9 implements only the original bundle, so unrestricted LLVM 23 v4 output is not 6.9-compatible.
